tools.name: servicem8_list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs (work orders, quotes, completed and unsuccessful jobs) with status, address, client and dates. Filter by status, active or edit_date. Page with next_cursor. ServiceM8 API: GET /job.json.

tools.name: servicem8_get_job
tools.description: Get one job by uuid: status, job and billing address, description, client, category, queue and invoice or payment fields. ServiceM8 API: GET /job/{uuid}.json.

tools.name: servicem8_list_clients
tools.description: List clients (customers). The REST name is company. Returns name, address and contact fields. Page with next_cursor. ServiceM8 API: GET /company.json.

tools.name: servicem8_get_client
tools.description: Get one client by uuid. ServiceM8 API: GET /company/{uuid}.json.

tools.name: servicem8_list_client_contacts
tools.description: List contacts that belong to clients (people at a client company). Page with next_cursor. ServiceM8 API: GET /companycontact.json.

tools.name: servicem8_list_staff
tools.description: List staff members (users of the ServiceM8 account) with name, role and active flag. Page with next_cursor. ServiceM8 API: GET /staff.json.

tools.name: servicem8_get_staff
tools.description: Get one staff member by uuid. ServiceM8 API: GET /staff/{uuid}.json.

tools.name: servicem8_list_job_activities
tools.description: List job activities: scheduled bookings (activity_was_scheduled = 1) and recorded check-in time on a job (activity_was_scheduled = 0). Page with next_cursor. ServiceM8 API: GET /jobactivity.json.

tools.name: servicem8_get_job_activity
tools.description: Get one job activity by uuid: a scheduled booking or recorded time. ServiceM8 API: GET /jobactivity/{uuid}.json.

tools.name: servicem8_list_job_materials
tools.description: List job material lines (quote and invoice line items) with quantity, price and job uuid. Page with next_cursor. ServiceM8 API: GET /jobmaterial.json.

tools.name: servicem8_list_job_contacts
tools.description: List contacts attached to jobs (on-site contact names and phone numbers). Page with next_cursor. ServiceM8 API: GET /jobcontact.json.

tools.name: servicem8_list_job_queues
tools.description: List job queues (the dispatch queues that hold unassigned jobs). Page with next_cursor. ServiceM8 API: GET /queue.json.

tools.name: servicem8_list_attachments
tools.description: List attachment records: job diary photos, quotes, invoices and work orders, with the job uuid and file name. Page with next_cursor. ServiceM8 API: GET /attachment.json.

tools.name: servicem8_get_attachment
tools.description: Get one attachment record by uuid (metadata, not the file). ServiceM8 API: GET /dboattachment/{uuid}.json.

tools.name: servicem8_create_job
tools.description: Create a job with a status and optional client, address, description, category and purchase order number. Returns the new job uuid. Creates data in the customer's ServiceM8 account. ServiceM8 API: POST /job.json.

tools.name: servicem8_update_job
tools.description: Change fields of one job. ServiceM8 requires status on every job update: pass the new status, or the current one to keep it. Other fields change only when passed. Repeating the same call gives the same result. ServiceM8 API: POST /job/{uuid}.json.
